description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {1}.
Repeat.
